$ edit testdata/grid/sheet.txtar  # export's cell has no committed outcome
$ go test  # chain-twice
    grid/sheet: A grid that export makes an export of, whose import makes a script of one quoted cell.
        export: Exports the grid, as its export/ tree says.
        out/export/outcome has no golden.
        Run FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./... to write it, and read it before committing.
    grid/sheet: A grid that export makes an export of, whose import makes a script of one quoted cell.
        import: Imports the export as a script, as its import/ tree says.
        out/import/outcome differs (-golden +got):
        - accepted
        + blocked export
        If the change is intended, run FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./... and read the diff before committing.
        via/import/quote/A1 is recorded, and import is blocked: the lift export, on import's path, has no committed outcome, out/export/outcome, which a normal run reads.
        export accepts the case now, so FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./... reruns it and runs import. Delete nothing by hand.

$ edit testdata/grid/sheet.txtar  # import's product back by hand
